cleaning_logic: The script performs the following cleaning steps in order: (1) Reads raw CSV as text and strips whitespace from all values, treating empty strings, 'NA', 'N/A', 'null', 'None', and '-' as missing values; (2) Removes duplicate records based on order_id, keeping the first occurrence; (3) Parses order_date using five supported formats and outputs as YYYY-MM-DD; (4) Maps region values case-insensitively to North/South/East/West, including single-letter abbreviations; (5) Maps product_category variants to the five standard categories; (6) Cleans unit_price by removing currency symbols and commas, validating range 0-5000; (7) Parses quantity as integer, validating it's a whole number between 1-50; (8) Parses discount_pct by removing trailing '%', defaulting missing values to 0, and validating range 0-100; (9) Converts customer_id to uppercase, replacing missing values with 'UNKNOWN'; (10) Calculates revenue as quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct/100) rounded to 2 decimals; (11) Outputs the cleaned data sorted by order_id with the specified column order.
